screenshot-toolkit.config.title: Screenshot Toolkit Settings
screenshot-toolkit.config.copyToClipboar: Copy every screenshot to the clipboard as an image, ready to paste into Discord or a chat. On Linux this needs wl-clipboard (Wayland) or xclip (X11).
screenshot-toolkit.config.showToast.tool: Show a small popup with a thumbnail instead of the chat message.
screenshot-toolkit.config.keepChatMessag: Also show the vanilla "Saved screenshot as" chat message.
screenshot-toolkit.config.saveMetadata.t: Remember the world, coordinates, dimension and time of each screenshot, for the gallery and its Copy /tp button. Stored in screenshots/.meta, never inside the image.
screenshot-toolkit.config.trashDays.tool: How long deleted screenshots stay in screenshots/.trash before they are removed for good.
